newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton closes steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Saturday as ginners slowed selling in the local markets after recent price falls, dealers said.
Prices have dipped in the past few days because ginners holding stocks of more than 1.2 million 375-lb bales had begun to unload them, one dealer said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 was quoted at 2,100/2,250 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) according to the quality, K-68 at 2,425/2,475 and MNH-93 at 2,450/2,500, the dealer said.
